role: mobile coastal consumer linking shallow productivity and reef shelter
realWorldReferents: sea bream for a readable generalist body
silhouette: A deep-bodied coastal fish with a forked tail, readable paired fins, and a continuous family profile that becomes longer in exposed water or deeper and broader around structure.

continuous.name: depthControl
continuous.driver: vertical movement through the water column

source.procedure: Run node assets/ecosystem/epoch-coastal-forager/source/generate-coastal-forager.mjs. A deterministic topology generator is used because the existing WebGPU renderer requires topology-stable per-instance morph targets; the authored fish remains one bounded family rather than a rotated land-animal rig.
